get.description: Read an independent native collection SLA configuration detail.

lookup.name: slaConfigId
lookup.description: Native nonblank slaConfigId from List or a verified product record.

summary: Collection SLA configuration targets and native detail.
purpose: Inspect end-to-end and internal SLA targets, not measured payment performance.

fields.name: endToEndSla
fields.meaning: Native end-to-end SLA target in seconds; nullable values retained.

fields.name: ipayInnerSla
fields.meaning: Native internal SLA target in seconds; nullable values retained.

fields.name: holidayLimit
fields.meaning: Native nullable holiday settings; array order and values retained.

identity_description: Nonblank native string slaConfigId; ASCII numeric IDs ordered by numeric value then original string, followed by other IDs lexically.
limitations: One fixed first1000 List request with native total/unique-count checks; width is qualified, maximum capacity is not established.
Local filters are exact and case-sensitive: repeated values OR, dimensions AND; no backend business selectors.
List and Get retain their independent full native roots. List-only viewProcessInstanceRequired is not fabricated into Get.
Get and --with-detail are live-only and do not write saved List cache or Duckdog data. --with-detail queries only the selected output window.
These configuration targets do not establish measured arrival times or transaction performance.
